caption:
Mr Turtle spends hours a day at the microscope. One more sample, and his head has crept forward again.

Leaning forward and holding still for long stretches can tire the neck. Setting up the chair and eyepieces so you can sit back, plus short regular breaks, can help.

Hybi's lab reset: sit back in an adjusted chair, look up into the distance every 20–30 minutes, chin tucks 5 seconds × 10, and shoulder blade squeezes 5 seconds × 10.

Headaches alongside it, arm tingling, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🔬

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
